title: AgentBoundaryExpansionRequest.v1
description: An agent consumer's REQUEST to widen its own boundary on the Teleon Agent Capability Gateway — add a capability/tool/domain, raise a cost ceiling, or loosen a policy. This is the ONE channel by which a boundary can change, and it is deliberately a request, not an action: the agent cannot self-expand purpose/secrets/domains, promote candidates, or weaken success criteria. status is pinned const 'pending_human_approval' and auto_applied is pinned const false — the request SITS until an accountable human approves it out-of-band; nothing here takes effect by itself. justification records WHY for the human reviewer. Law: agents ASK, Teleon EXECUTES, Baltor governs truth — and an agent never expands its own boundary.

request_id.description: caller-assigned id for this boundary-expansion request

consumer_id.description: the AgentCapabilityConsumer asking to widen its boundary

capability_id.description: the capability the change concerns (the capability the consumer wants to reach, or whose policy it wants loosened)

requested_change.description: the boundary change being requested (e.g. {add_capability}, {add_allowed_domain}, {raise_max_cost}, {loosen_policy}) — described, never applied

justification.description: the agent's stated reason for the change, recorded for the human reviewer to weigh

status.description: ALWAYS 'pending_human_approval' — the request never auto-approves; it sits until an accountable human approves it out-of-band

auto_applied.description: ALWAYS false — a boundary expansion is never applied automatically; an agent cannot self-expand its boundary
